mine_news.headline: Austin Reaves: Listed as day-to-day
mine_news.body: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

mine_news.headline: Klay Thompson: Ruled out Friday
mine_news.body: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.

mine_news.headline: Amen Thompson: Double-doubles vs. Utah
mine_news.body: Thompson posted 12 points (4-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 11 rebounds, three assists and one block over 41 minutes in a 125-118 win over the Jazz on Friday.

mine_news.headline: Victor Wembanyama, Spurs open on 18-0 run, rout Warriors for 11th straight win
mine_news.body: Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs pounced on the Warriors with an 18-0 opening run and went on to win 123-85.

mine_news.headline: Victor Wembanyama: Limited minutes in blowout
mine_news.body: Wembanyama ended with 12 points (5-11 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), 12 rebounds, six assists, two blocks and one steal in 21 minutes during Friday's 123-85 win over Golden State.
